Accomplishment
1. Actor, Producer, and Writer/Translator for TV, Film, and Stage, Starred in and Produced the Award-Winning Short Film “A Starbucks Story”, “Stan” and the Writer, Actor, and Producer of Movie “Formosa Betrayed”

2. Founder and President of Formosa Films LLC and Owner of Tiao Properties

3. An International Economist for Bill Clinton and George W. Bush Administrations

4. Legislative Fellow for the Committee on Ways and Means in the U.S. House of Representatives

5. Staffer for Senator Nancy Kassebaum on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee

6. Employee of the Formosan Association for Public Affairs

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019

Publication(Non-professional)
1. TV credits: MADtv (FOX), Yes, Dear (CBS), Untold Stories from the ER (TLC), Mind of Mencia (Comedy Central), The Winner (FOX), and the internet series Quarterlife.

2. Theatre credits: Waiting for Lefty, Extremities, Marty, In the Boom Boom Room, and Proof
